findings.message: B1 (assessment): "twelve characters" is stated for the 11-character password Pk!9#mQ2vLx in four places: unit-assessment.mdx line 147 (MCQ-3 rationale), unit-assessment.mdx lines 175-177 (RRQ-6 model answer), the rendered table text of static/img/figures/gict-300/unit-04/fig-U4-6.svg and fig-U4-6.dark.svg, and specs/content/gict-300/figures/unit-04.md line 17 (prompt). Count: P-k-!-9-#-m-Q-2-v-L-x = 11. The miscount also hides that the exemplar falls one character short of the unit's own cited guidance (Bourgeois et al. 2019, "at least 12 random characters", topic-03.mdx lines 38-41), so a learner who counts finds the figure contradicting itself. Repair: correct the count to eleven (or, better, extend the exemplar to 12+ characters so it embodies the cited guidance) in both MDX rationales, both English SVG variants, the manifest prompt row, and the paired Urdu mirror (fig-U4-6.ur.svg already carries the same miscount as "بارہ").

B2 (sources): specs/content/gict-300/sources/unit-04.md lines 3-6 preamble still claims "the registry-verified keys and the guide-required keys are also cited in prose". The registry-verified half is now true (bourgeois2019, nistCloud2011 as Mell and Grance 2011, erendorYildirim2022 all appear in body prose), but the guide-required keys do not: laudonLaudon appears only at topic-02.mdx lines 136-137 and stairReynolds only at topic-04.mdx lines 137-138, both inside Further reading and both self-described as "cited at bibliographic level". This is a residual of run-001 finding F4 (false preamble), whose repair fixed the unused-source half but not this clause. Repair: restrict the prose-citation claim to the registry-verified keys and state the guide-required keys are cited at bibliographic level in Further reading only, matching their own table rows and the D-2026-0001 declarations.

A1 (concepts, residual of run-001 A7): after the bank redistribution two concept-graph mappings are stale. concepts/unit-04.md line 20 maps RRQ-03 to CON:GICT-300-4-4 (CIA triad), but RRQ-03 is the phishing-tells item and contains no CIA content; line 26 maps RRQ-08 to CON:GICT-300-4-10 (Authentication factors), but RRQ-08 is the cloud question (correctly listed under CON:GICT-300-4-12 line 28). The a7200d2 remap updated CON:4-12 and the 4.2/4.4 rows but left these two. check:concept-graph validates linkage structurally, not semantically, so it cannot catch this.

A2 (spec figure plan, residual of run-001 A8): specs/content/gict-300/content-spec.md lines 322-324 still describe fig-U4-7 as "where your file goes when you save it to the cloud (4.3)", while the delivered figure is the pupil-record four-questions diagram placed in 4.4 (spec topic list line 307; figures/unit-04.md line 18; topic-04.mdx line 33). U4-05 (cloud computing basics) is left without its planned visual; 4.3 still meets the two-figure density gate with fig-U4-5 and fig-U4-6. NOTE for the parent: a7200d2's commit message (and the run-002 handoff) claim this line was aligned with the delivered figure, but the spec file was last modified at 708d85c - the claimed repair was not carried out.

A3 (residual of run-001 A9): the course-wide reading list (content-spec.md "## Reading list") assigns stairReynolds to units 1, 2, 6, while Unit 4's own governance (mapped readings, sources/unit-04.md, coverage reinforcement) uses it for U4-06. One of the two assignments should change.

A4 (residual of run-001 A12): 11 bare-URL link texts remain in Further reading sections (render tool: topic-01 four, topic-02 two, topic-03 three, topic-04 two). Descriptive link text would serve screen-reader users better; not a WCAG failure at this severity.

A5 (residual of run-001 A15): the spec blueprint asks for "one integrative item producing a data-protection plan for a school"; the delivered integrative item (ERQ-5) is an evaluation essay on "Online safety is a set of habits, not a product you can buy", and the data-protection plan is delivered as the topic-4.4 ERQ-4. ERQ-4 does connect 4.4 to Topic 4.1 and the vendor scenario, so the mapping is defensible, but the integrative slot is not the plan the blueprint names.

A6 (tooling, residual of run-001 A11): the ADR-0027 citation-key regex in scripts/lib/review-evidence.mjs does not match camelCase keys, so sources/texts/nistCloud2011.md and sources/texts/erendorYildirim2022.md are not digest-bound in this review's input manifest even though the unit cites both. I verified both files at HEAD during this review: sha256 5e1b79f72539e0652cd1ed00fb8e70b442d67e5a3e30f8ed4f51eef100097de6 (nistCloud2011.md) and 5b0fc2174562a5bc3f63868dfde0e17aecc97b51bb783b39340fb01339095523 (erendorYildirim2022.md), both last committed at 702fb1d. A regex fix belongs to the review-evidence tooling, not this unit.

A7 (sources governance): the erendorYildirim2022 Supports cell (sources/unit-04.md line 19) says "education measurably matters"; the retrieved abstract concludes cybersecurity education "should be given" - a recommendation, not a measured effect of education. The learner prose (topic-01.mdx lines 92-96) stays within the abstract (weak awareness despite heavy use), so this overstatement is confined to the governance table.

A8 (environment, out of scope for this unit): at HEAD e12079a five of the six contract gates exit 1 solely on the stale geng-300 tree: validate:content (13 front-matter errors, all docs/semester-1/geng-300/unit-01), check:depth-gate (4 failures, GENG-300 Unit 1), check:figures (1, GENG-300 Unit 1), check:no-em-dash (9 em dashes, all specs/content/geng-300/intake/evaluation.md, unchanged since a3077f7), check:no-answer-keys (2 matches, both geng-300 build pages). Zero GICT-300 findings in any gate. I re-ran all five over a scoped overlay (CONTENT_ROOT=/tmp/g3-run002-overlay: the repo bytes minus the geng-300 course, with the GICT-300 inputs verified byte-identical to this review's manifest) and all exit 0; logs retained (*-overlay.txt). The parent should either land the sibling branch's geng-300 repairs or keep using the disclosed overlay method, as the G2 evidence already does.

Run-001 F1 (RRQ distribution) RESOLVED: RRQs now map 3/2/3/2 across topics 4.1-4.4 (new 4.2 traces item RRQ-04, new 4.3 cloud item RRQ-08, new 4.4 items RRQ-09/RRQ-10), satisfying the >= 2 per topic blueprint; MCQs 3/2/3/2; ERQs one per topic plus integrative.

Run-001 F2 (I Love You citation beyond the excerpt) RESOLVED: topic-01.mdx lines 46-47 now say "hit roughly 50,000 computers (Bourgeois et al., 2019)" and the bound excerpt (bourgeois2019.md lines 113-114) was corrected to match; I independently fetched chapter 6 of the live second edition at opentextbook.site and confirmed "An estimated 50,000 computers were affected", so the excerpt edit was legitimate, not fabrication.

Run-001 F3 (sources mapping overstatements) RESOLVED: the bourgeois2019 Supports cell now reads "the CIA triad, password guidance and threat families (U4-01, U4-02, U4-04)" and the coverage reinforcement rows no longer claim bourgeois2019 for U4-03/U4-06.

Run-001 F4 (unused source and false preamble) PARTIALLY RESOLVED: erendorYildirim2022 is now cited in body prose (topic-01.mdx lines 92-96, the 517-student survey claim verified against the bound abstract) with a corrected Supports cell; the preamble was rewritten but remains false for the guide-required keys - carried forward as blocking finding B2.
Run-001 F5 (MCQ answer-position skew) RESOLVED: the key is now 2a/2b/3c/3d (b, d, c, a, c, d, b, a, c, d); my independently derived key matches 10/10 and no position dominates.

Run-001 A6 (RRQ-10 model answer) RESOLVED: the redistributed RRQ-10 model cleanly classifies photographs and parent contact numbers as personal data and health notes as sensitive, with handling duties; no scenario confusion remains.

Run-001 A10 (PECA 2016 uncited/declaration gap) RESOLVED: the ncsp2021 declaration now covers the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act 2016 at name level, and the topic-04 claim (criminalises unauthorised access to and copying of data) is accurate at that level of description.

Run-001 A13 (stale G2 evidence) RESOLVED by the parent: the refreshed gates file specs/content/gict-300/reviews/unit-04/G2/20260923T214817844Z-gates.json is bound to an input manifest identical (101/101 digests) to this review's, with all 8 draft gates at exit 0.

Run-001 A14 (handoff commit label mismatch) RESOLVED: the run-002 handoff's "prepared at commit e12079a" matches the bound digests; I recomputed all 101 digests with inputManifest() at review start and again at review end with zero mismatches.
